name: Pacific Transformer
old_description: Custom, distribution, padmount, and PDU transformers (CA plant is secondary to overseas)
about:
Pacific Transformer was founded in 1981 in a garage in Anaheim, California, by three softball teammates who each borrowed $1,300 from their parents. The company remains founder-owned and headquartered in Anaheim, with a domestic production facility that serves as a backup for its international operations in Mexico, Thailand, and China.

The company designs and manufactures custom magnetic components — transformers (1 VA to 1,000 kVA), toroidals, inductors, chokes, and power-supply assemblies — for applications ranging from signal-level to utility-scale. Engineering services include free design, computer modeling, and rapid prototyping; quotes are returned within one business day and wound, tested prototypes ship within two business days from the Anaheim floor. Over 45 million transformers have been shipped to date.

Customers span aerospace (Mars rovers, NASA flight hardware), defense (nuclear submarine systems), medical imaging, EV infrastructure (Tesla Superchargers), professional audio (Trainwreck amplifiers), industrial automation, data centers, and renewable energy. The firm works with both startups needing a single prototype and established manufacturers placing hundreds of units annually.

Pacific Transformer emphasizes “everything around the winding”: free engineering, agency-approval expertise (UL, CSA, CE, ETL, TÜV), a domestic failover facility that mitigates supply-chain risk, and pricing leveraged from its overseas plants. The company holds AS9100D, MIL-PRF-27, ISO 9001, and ITAR registrations.

name: Packaging Support Group
old_description: At PSG, we believe in a new kind of packaging company. Instead of offering only one piece of the packaging puzzle, we decided to focus on handling whatever our customers need to get their products ready and on the shelf.
about:
Packaging Support Group (PSG) operates from Jonesboro, Arkansas. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials. It presents itself as a distributor focused on providing complete packaging solutions rather than a single product line.

PSG supplies a broad range of stock packaging containers and closures, including glass bottles and jars, plastic containers (HDPE, PET), and metal and plastic closures. The company maintains an e-commerce catalog with hundreds of SKUs, such as straight-sided jars, stout bottles, economy jars, and industrial pails. It also offers global procurement services and warehousing from its Jonesboro facility to support customer inventory needs.

The distributor serves markets such as candle making, honey packaging, food and beverage, and general industrial packaging. Its product collections are organized around these end uses, with dedicated sections for candles, honey containers, and food-grade containers.

PSG emphasizes a “single-source” approach, aiming to handle whatever customers need to get products ready for the shelf. Its stated differentiation lies in combining global sourcing with domestic warehousing to simplify the packaging supply chain.

about:
Packaging Utah, a division of Traco Manufacturing Inc., has operated from Orem, Utah since 1985. The privately-owned business began as a packaging distributor and importer focused exclusively on serving Utah companies.

The company distributes a broad line of stock packaging supplies including corrugated boxes, stretch and shrink films, bags, tape, cushioning, and janitorial products. It also provides custom packaging design using CAD systems, digital label printing, shrink sleeve converting, and on-demand digital printing for runs from ten to over ten thousand units. Packaging Utah supplies equipment such as label applicators and heat tunnels alongside its materials.

Packaging Utah serves small, midsize, and large businesses throughout Utah, including product manufacturers needing custom labels for bottles and food containers, retail-ready flexible packaging, and multi-pack bundling. Its customer base spans companies requiring shipping supplies, void fill, and facility maintenance products.

The company positions itself as a one-stop packaging distributor for Utah businesses, combining stock and custom capabilities with local delivery and consulting support. It emphasizes quick, convenient shipping from its Orem facility and the flexibility of digital printing for short or long runs.

name: Pak Solutions
old_description: STEB’s are utilized in duty fee shop across the globe and are manufactured under the ICAO (International Civilian Airline Organization) guidelines. PAK Solutions is recognized as an approved manufacturer of this product.
about:
Pak Solutions operates from Lancaster, New Hampshire, where it has produced tamper-evident and specialty packaging since at least 2018. In June 2018 the business was acquired by an ownership group of professionals with deep ties to the New England region, giving the company new direction.

The company manufactures a range of security and packaging products including STEB duty-free bags, security deposit bags, vault bags, patient valuables bags, and glue-seal evidence bags. It also serves medical, food, e-commerce, and specialty packaging markets. Production capabilities center on flexo solvent printing and laminating, supported by an in-house graphics department for rapid artwork turnaround. A $7 million expansion announced in May 2020 added two flexo solvent presses, including a 2020 Koenig & Bauer press, to increase capacity.

Customers span healthcare facilities requiring sterile packaging, airlines and duty-free retailers using ICAO-compliant STEBs, food processors, e-commerce shippers, and law-enforcement agencies needing evidence-handling bags. The firm positions itself as a single-source supplier for tamper-evident and security packaging across these sectors.

Management emphasizes its status as a leader in tamper-evident packaging, backed by continuous equipment investment and an internal graphics team that shortens lead times on custom work. The ICAO approval for STEB production underscores its ability to meet stringent international standards.

old_description: Worked with PakRite on a personal and business projects in the past and they have always been fantastic! Amazing selection, very professional staff and fair pricing! They will always be my go to choice for cases and custom inserts!
about:
Pak-Rite, Ltd. Michigan was established in 1946 in Wixom, Michigan, a suburb northwest of Detroit. The company operates as a third-generation, family-owned business that has evolved into a full-service packaging design and manufacturing firm serving the Midwest and beyond.

The company designs and manufactures custom packaging solutions ranging from basic shipping containers to complex foam and plastic inserts produced via CNC cutting. Its capabilities include engineered wood packaging, foam components, plastic components, and custom crating, all supported by in-house CAD design, 3D modeling, and laser scanning. Pak-Rite emphasizes no tooling or set-up charges and handles prototype through production volumes with high-tolerance precision.

Pak-Rite serves the aerospace industry, as indicated by its dedicated industry page, and provides custom packaging for diverse applications such as communications equipment cases, military-grade foam inserts for companies like B&W North America, and specialized firearm cases for hunting travel. The firm also operates as an authorized Pelican Products outlet, supplying cases, coolers, and accessories.

The company states its differentiation lies in personalized service, attention to detail, on-time delivery, and consistent customer satisfaction. It prioritizes U.S.-based suppliers and proudly manufactures all products in the USA, while investing in state-of-the-art technology to deliver economical, environmentally friendly, high-quality packaging.

name: PakTech
old_description: Since 2012, PakTech has repurposed over half a billion gallon-sized milk jugs into new packaging handles, keeping roughly 80 million pounds out of the waste stream. Manufacturing our products with 100% recycled and recyclable material generates 78% less greenhouse gases, uses 90% less energy, and reduces virgin petroleum production by 100%. And after they’ve been used, PakTech handles can be recycled again – we’ve partnered with more than 500 businesses to establish dedicated recycling sites, so our handles can live again as park benches, planter pots, and new PakTech products.
about:
PakTech is headquartered in Eugene, Oregon. The family-owned company was founded in 1991, originally operating as a job shop producing molds for injection-molding firms before pivoting to manufacturing its own injection-molded handles from recycled HDPE for the beverage industry.

Today PakTech designs and manufactures 100% recyclable multi-pack handles and automated in-line application equipment. The handles are injection molded from 100% post-consumer recycled HDPE, sourced from materials such as milk jugs. The company also supplies the applicators that integrate into packaging lines for high-speed multi-packing.

PakTech serves the food, beverage, and consumer goods sectors, including household products. Its handles are used to multi-pack soft drinks, beer, wine, cider, kombucha, craft cocktails, coffee, juice, water, cleaning supplies, and health and beauty items. Customers range from established corporations to start-up manufacturers.

The company was built on a commitment to environmentally friendly manufacturing, using 100% recycled and recyclable HDPE to reduce waste and greenhouse gas emissions. Its mission emphasizes smart, low-waste packaging handles, turnkey automated equipment, superior product quality, customer service, and long-term partnerships. PakTech's recycled content is certified by SCS Global Services, and it has established recycling partnerships with over 500 businesses to keep handles in a circular loop.

name: Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC
old_description: Needed a pin and weld and was greeted with the best customer service, Amanda is amazing, and Michael is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for welding services. Among the rest ! ! !
about:
Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC was founded in February 2019 by Amanda Koch and Michael Meyer in Summerville, South Carolina. The couple met in 2017 while Michael was working as a contract welder in Wyoming, and they relocated with their families to the Charleston area in 2018. Amanda brought 20 years of office management experience, primarily in oil and gas, while Michael had spent his career in welding across industries such as oil and gas, marine, nuclear, automotive, and structural steel.

The company provides structural steel fabrication and erection, miscellaneous steel fabrication and installation, and aluminum fabrication and erection. Its shop includes a plasma burn table capable of cutting plate up to 1 inch thick. In January 2020 the firm acquired a 9,500‑square‑foot facility on two acres and employed 17 skilled workers, with plans to expand into a 30,000‑square‑foot building in early 2022.

Palmetto Welding serves customers in construction, automotive, and general industrial markets. Testimonials highlight work on automotive trailing‑arm reinforcements and pin‑and‑weld services, while the company’s structural steel erection capabilities target commercial and industrial building projects. Michael Meyer’s background in nuclear and marine welding also informs the shop’s quality standards.

The business was started after Michael identified a local need for skilled, affordable welding services for both production and mobile work. The company says it differentiates itself through AISC certification in both fabrication and erection, which allows it to bid on projects with stringent quality‑control requirements, and through a commitment to adapting its operations to client needs.

The company remains a solo venture, with Rick noting that woodworking is a second job alongside his primary employment.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and built-in pieces, handling both fabrication and installation. name: Paradigm Foodworks Inc
old_description: Shipping to US addresses only. Free shipping at $75.00 for orders within the contiguous 48 US states.
about:
Paradigm Foodworks Inc operates from Lake Oswego, Oregon, where it has been producing small-batch artisanal foods since 1981. The company is woman-owned, though founder names are not publicly disclosed. Its origins trace back to a focus on handcrafted condiments and preserves made in limited quantities.

The manufacturer produces a wide range of sauces, condiments, spreads, and jellies across more than ten product lines. These include charcuterie condiments, dessert sauces, fruit and berry spreads, barbecue and grill sauces, mustards and horseradish, pizza and pasta sauces, salad dressings, salsa and enchilada sauces, as well as Indian-inspired Masala Maza and Asian fusion Heaven & Earth lines. Specific items such as Apple Jalapeño Jelly, Apricot Cognac Conserve, and Arrabbiata Sauce illustrate the flavor breadth. Production is described as small batch, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Paradigm Foodworks sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website, shipping to addresses within the contiguous 48 United States with free shipping on orders over $75. The product assortment suggests it also serves specialty food retailers, gourmet shops, and food-service operators seeking artisanal condiments, though wholesale channels are not explicitly detailed in the available information.

The company emphasizes its long-standing commitment to small-batch craftsmanship, a practice maintained since its 1981 founding. Its woman-owned status further distinguishes it in the specialty food sector.
